description: Tasman River Valleys Flood 0.1m Aerial Photos Index Tiles (2025) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Imagery. Index Tiles ONLY, for actual orthophotos see layer Tasman River Valleys Flood 0. 1m Aerial Photos (2025) Orthophotography within the Tasman region captured in the 2025 flying season, published as a record of the Tasman River Valleys Flood event. Imagery was captured for Tasman District Council by Aerial Surveys on 17 July 2025. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Imagery. Its tags are imageryBaseMapsEarthCover. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
